comment_regular: Verified periodic update dispatch: when this effect's update condition is met, ActiveEffect_Base_ProcessEffect calls vtable +0x08 with elapsed-time data. LockEffect/OpenEffect use the shared null implementation at this slot, so their lock changes occur through Apply (+0x38), not the periodic update override.
